maya_cs: FYI prepping Apollo QBR appendix. Onboarding cohort #3 tripped a big token surge after embeddings enablement. Need quick triage + a short enablement session. :eyes:
liam_csm: Saw the spike alert early this morning. Any numbers? avg vs observed?
olivia_finops: Quick pull: expected ~120k tokens/day, actual ~430k tokens/day for the cohort. Commit is 50k credits/month. If sustained monthly, that's ~9.3M tokens (~$3.7k).
sam_engineer: billing-bot posted automated alert 08:44: `usage_anomaly: account=apollo pct_change=+258%`. Root cause appears to be client config: embeddings cache disabled.
maya_cs: Can you paste the offending snippet so we can give the customer a copy-paste fix?
sam_engineer: Heres the snippet:
```
// client config
client.configure({ embeddings: { cache: false, batch_size: 8 } })
```
Recommend `cache: true` and batch_size=32-64 depending on client memory.
liam_csm: For the QBR appendix: 1) timeline, 2) root cause, 3) immediate mitigations, 4) revised forecast, 5) recommended guardrails. Maya, want a 5-slide appendix?
maya_cs: Yep. Also should we propose a temporary quota while they patch the SDK?
olivia_finops: Yes: suggest soft cap of 5 reqs/sec for embeddings for 48 hours, alert if 24h spend > $1,500, and auto-throttle policy with rollback steps in case of false positives. Include estimated savings slide.
liam_csm: I'll handle customer outreach + run the enablement walkthrough. @sam_engineer can you make a one-line snippet and a gist that the CSM can send?
sam_engineer: Will do. Creating gist with code + short explainer. ETA ~30m.
billing-bot: automated: created ticket CS-8397 "Apollo embedding surge - triage & QBR appendix"
maya_cs: Scheduling a 30min enablement session Friday 10am PT. Agenda: quick SDK fix, caching best practices, monitoring checkpoints. Anyone object?
olivia_finops: Works. I'll prepare cost delta slide and a remediation timeline with action items.
liam_csm: Add renewal-risk checklist: if post-fix burn remains >2x commit for 7 days, flag for finance review. Also propose a pre-commit buffer for future cohorts.
maya_cs: Noted. Uploading draft appendix to shared QBR folder and will ping when ready. Playbook ref: https://redwood-internal/playbooks/onboarding-costs
sam_engineer: Gist live: https://gist.github.com/sam/def456  includes `cache: true` example + recommended batching and a monitoring snippet to emit a low-cost alert.
maya_cs: Perfect. I'll circulate to Apollo CSM, attach the appendix, and send the calendar invite. :white_check_mark:
liam_csm: Thanks team. After Friday, we'll add the recommended guardrails into the account template and include explicit SDK checks in onboarding checklist.
maya_cs: Closing loop once slides + gist are in the QBR folder.
